tagline.zh: 写剧本 → 排分镜 → 生成素材 → 预览成片素材，一套装齐
tagline.en: Script → storyboard → generate assets → preview them, installed in one go

tagline.zh: 登录 VibeDev 账号，和 DeepSeek 账号并存：用网关的 Claude、GPT 等模型，并让 Agent 生成图片、视频、音乐、播客和语音
tagline.en: Sign in to VibeDev next to your DeepSeek account: use the gateway's Claude, GPT and other models, and let the agent generate images, video, music, podcasts and speech

zh: 在侧边栏底部或「设置 → VibeDev 账号」登录，查看余额、充值；和 DeepSeek 账号互不影响
余额实时更新：对话、生成、转写扣费后几秒内就能看到
登录后模型选择器里多出「VibeDev」一组（Claude、GPT 等），未登录时不显示
生成图片；带参考图时可改图、换风格
生成视频（后台运行，一般 1–10 分钟）
生成音乐（可自带歌词）、播客和语音（可用参考音色）；音频模型按网关声明的能力识别；把语音转成文字
原名 dsh-media：已安装的会在这里一键切换，登录和进行中的任务都保留
en: Sign in at the bottom of the sidebar or in Settings → VibeDev account, see the balance and top up; the DeepSeek account is not affected
Live balance: a charge from a chat, a generation or a transcription shows within seconds
Once signed in, the model picker gains a "VibeDev" group (Claude, GPT and more); nothing is listed while signed out
Generate images; edit or restyle with reference images
Generate video (runs in the background, usually 1-10 minutes)
Generate music (with your own lyrics), podcasts and speech (with reference voices); audio models are recognized from what the gateway declares; transcribe speech
Formerly dsh-media: an installed copy is switched over here in one click, keeping the sign-in and running tasks

text.zh: 发给 VibeDev 模型的对话、提示词和参考素材会发送到 VibeDev 网关，再转交模型服务商
text.en: Conversations with VibeDev models, prompts and reference media are sent to the VibeDev gateway, which forwards them to the model provider

text.zh: 在系统浏览器里登录 VibeDev，插件拿不到密码；登录凭据存在 DeepSeek Harness 的凭据存储里。在 VibeDev 应用里直接用已登录的账号
text.en: You sign in to VibeDev in your system browser and the plugin never sees the password; the sign-in is kept in DeepSeek Harness's credential store. Inside the VibeDev app the app's account is used

text.zh: 生成结果保存在工作区的 media/ 目录
text.en: Results are saved under media/ in the workspace

text.zh: 为 Agent 增加 7 个媒体工具和简短说明
text.en: Adds 7 media tools and a short guide for the agent

text.zh: VibeDev 模型按用量计费；图片按张、视频按秒或按次、音乐和播客按次、语音按原始秒、转写按分钟计费，没有价格的显示「未定价」；失败和取消的任务不扣费，提交后的视频无法取消
text.en: VibeDev models are billed by usage; images per image, video per second or per generation, music and podcasts per request, speech per second of original audio, transcription per minute, "not priced" when no price is stated; failed and cancelled tasks are not charged and a submitted video cannot be cancelled

tagline.zh: 在右侧栏打开画布式影视工作台：小说拆解、剧本、分镜画布、图片/视频/音频生成、剪辑成片
tagline.en: A canvas film workbench in the right sidebar: novel breakdown, script, storyboard canvas, image / video / audio generation and editing

zh: 画布式工作台：小说拆解、剧本、分镜、导演台、剪辑成片，在会话右侧栏打开
图片、视频、音频生成节点都走 VibeDev 账号；发送键旁显示预计费用
音频节点支持音乐、播客和语音，只显示所选模型支持的参数；刷新页面不会重复生成
Agent 可以用影视工具搭建画布、调用节点，另带影视技能
从旧版影视工作台升级：配置条目不变，旧项目文件保留
只支持 Windows x64（Bun 运行时随插件安装，不用另装）
en: Canvas workbench: novel breakdown, script, storyboard, director desk and editing, opened in the session's right sidebar
Image, video and audio generation nodes all go through the VibeDev account, with the expected cost beside the send button
The audio node does music, podcasts and speech, showing only the options the chosen model supports; a reload never generates twice
The agent can build the canvas and drive nodes with film tools, plus film skills
Upgrading from the earlier film workbench keeps the profile entry and the old project files
Windows x64 only (the Bun runtime is installed with it; nothing else to install)

text.zh: 项目保存在工作区的「VibeDev Film」文件夹，生成结果在项目的 assets/ 下；升级和卸载插件不会改动它们
text.en: Projects are kept in the workspace's "VibeDev Film" folder and results under the project's assets/; upgrading or removing the plugin does not touch them

text.zh: 在本机回环地址上运行工作台服务，只接受本插件签发的会话
text.en: Runs the workbench server on a loopback address, accepting only sessions this plugin issues

text.zh: 为 Agent 增加影视工具（打开工作台、列出与调用画布操作）和影视技能
text.en: Adds film tools (open the workbench, list and call canvas operations) and film skills for the agent

text.zh: 生成节点按 VibeDev 价格扣费，发送前在节点上显示预计费用；失败的任务不扣费
text.en: Generation nodes are charged at VibeDev prices, with the expected cost shown on the node before sending; failed tasks are not charged

why.zh: 只支持 Windows x64；音频生成需要 VibeDev 账号与模型 0.3.1 及以上
why.en: Windows x64 only; audio generation needs VibeDev Account & Models 0.3.1 or later

tagline.zh: 在右侧栏直接预览视频、音频和 HTML，按文件夹浏览媒体画廊，多选加入影视画布
tagline.en: Preview video, audio and HTML right in the sidebar, browse a folder as a media gallery, and add picks to the film canvas

zh: 视频：可拖进度条、倍速、循环，不限文件大小
音频：实时频谱、倍速、循环
HTML：默认允许脚本，在隔离沙箱里运行；可看源码、切换手机/平板/桌面宽度
媒体画廊：缩略图、按类型筛选、搜索、灯箱浏览；多选后加入影视工作台画布
直接用 DSH 自带的右侧栏，不需要其他插件
en: Video: seekable, speed control, loop, no file-size cap
Audio: live spectrum, speed control, loop
HTML: scripts allowed by default, inside an isolated sandbox; view source, switch phone/tablet/desktop width
Media gallery: thumbnails, type filters, search, lightbox; multi-select and add to the Film Studio canvas
Uses DSH's own right sidebar; no other plugin needed

text.zh: 只读取当前会话工作目录内的文件
text.en: Reads only files inside the current session's working directory

text.zh: 在本机服务上增加 /mp 路由，仅回环地址可访问
text.en: Adds /mp routes to the local server, reachable from loopback only

text.zh: HTML 预览默认允许脚本，运行在无法访问界面的隔离沙箱中
text.en: HTML preview allows scripts by default, inside a sandbox that cannot reach the UI

tagline.zh: 浏览、搜索并一键安装社区里的插件，也能管理更新和停用
tagline.en: Browse, search and one-click install community plugins; also manages updates and disabling

zh: 浏览和搜索社区插件目录（数据来自 awesome-dsh-plugin）
一键安装、更新、停用和卸载；多数插件刷新页面即可用
插件分组与备注、备份与恢复插件清单、主题一键切换
en: Browse and search the community catalog (data from awesome-dsh-plugin)
One-click install, update, disable and uninstall; most plugins work after a page reload
Plugin groups and notes, backup/restore of the plugin list, one-click themes

text.zh: 读取公共插件目录，并通过 pnpm 下载安装插件
text.en: Reads the public plugin catalog and downloads plugins through pnpm

text.zh: 安装、启用、停用会修改你的插件配置文件
text.en: Installing, enabling and disabling modify your plugin configuration

text.zh: 由 dsh-market 团队维护（MIT），本中心不审查其代码；其 README 声明不向任何地方上报数据
text.en: Maintained by the dsh-market team (MIT); this center does not review its code; its README states it reports no data anywhere

why.zh: 在 VibeDev Next 里已能正常加载（本机观察，未做系统测试）
why.en: Loads fine in VibeDev Next (observed locally; not systematically tested)
